caseName: National Federation of Independent Business v. Sebelius
caseNameFull: National Federation of Independent Business v. Kathleen Sebelius, Secretary of Health and Human Services Florida v. Department of Health and Human Services

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit in No. 11-393, granted. Petition for writ of certio-rari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit in No. 11-400 granted, limited to the issue of severability presented by Question 3 of the petition. The cases are consolidated and a total of 90 minutes is allotted for oral argument.

Same cases below, 648 F.3d 1235.
